hints.title: Augmented Subsequence DP
hints.text: Consider how to form a symmetric sequence by either matching boundary characters or skipping characters while tracking remaining modification operations.

hints.title: Cyclic Alphabet Distance
hints.text: For a substring s[i..j], the cost to equate characters s[i] and s[j] cyclically is min(|s[i] - s[j]|, 26 - |s[i] - s[j]|).

hints.title: State Transitions and Budget
hints.text: At state (i, j, rem_k), choose between skipping s[i], skipping s[j], or matching s[i] and s[j] if rem_k >= cost.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Interval DP augmented with operation budget tracking cyclic character distances.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching over all subsequences and possible character shifts is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Cyclic distance computation combined with interval DP caches repeated subproblems.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate 3D state (i, j, rem_k) and handle alphabet wrap-around arithmetic.
